description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different methods across two evaluation categories, presented visually at a tilted angle. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered from left to right as "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0.0 to above 0.6 with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. Within each category, the data is displayed as a grouped set of two columns. The left column of each group is a single solid orange bar, which lacks a corresponding legend entry in the visible area. The right column is a stacked bar composed of two segments: a bottom light orange segment representing "RMU" and a top pale yellow segment representing "RMU with Enhanced GCG", as indicated by the legend. In the "MCQ Eval" category, the left orange bar is the tallest in the chart with an annotated value of 0.644, while the adjacent stacked bar has a bottom segment annotated at 0.299 and a total height annotated at 0.539. In the "Generation Eval" category, the left orange bar has an annotated value of 0.597, and the adjacent stacked bar is the shortest overall column, featuring a bottom segment annotated at 0.106 and a total height annotated at 0.263. All bars are outlined in black, and exact numeric values are annotated directly on or above their respective segments, with no specific sorting applied to the horizontal categories.
